commits.message:
fix(table): read ratio weights as the decimals written, over bidding columns only (rich-table-iq0)

Review of #212: scaling the binary doubles made 0.1 : 0.3 : 1 split unlike
1 : 3 : 10, since 0.3 is not exactly three 0.1s in binary. exactWeights now
reads each weight as the decimal it prints as and scales by a power of ten,
and runs only over the demands that bid, so a closed column cannot throw or
inflate the common scale.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(table): distribute breaks fractional ties by the leftmost column, exactly (rich-table-iq0)

The largest-remainder pass compared share fractions as doubles, so two
exactly equal remainders (6/14 and 6/14 for 16 cells over 1:3:10) compared
unequal by rounding error and the spare cell went right. distribute now
scales the weights to one power-of-two denominator and runs in BigInt, so
fractions compare exactly; an Infinity budget is bounded by the open wants
before it reaches integer arithmetic.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(docs): type-check the shape and node examples (rich-docs-jqc) (#211)

* feat(docs): type-check the shape and node examples, which no gate compiled (rich-docs-jqc)

The build compiled every block it runs, chain and live, and nothing else:
a `shape` or `node` block could call a constructor with the wrong arguments
and pass. Each such block is now type-checked as the program of its own a
live block is — its imports, the prelude, the page's exampleContext, and the
block — so it fails the build at its page and line like any other.

docs/traceback.md's index.ts fence imported the reader's own files
(`./crash-reporting.js`, `./server.js`). No page can supply those, and
TypeScript refuses an ambient declaration of a relative module (TS2436), so
there is no context to declare; the fence made no library claim to check.
It is now the sentence it was teaching: make that import the entry file's
first.

* refactor(docs): one pass checks every block outside the chain; correct two stale explanations (rich-docs-jqc)

Review fixes from /code-review high on #211.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(runner): step 7 no longer claims live blocks are type-checked twice (rich-docs-jqc)

fix(table): draw with Table.style and Column's three styles, as the reference does (rich-table-jph)

Table.style is the base the border style layers over; a column's headerStyle and
footerStyle layer over the table's, and its style sits under the row's rowStyles
entry. The cell's style now covers its padding and the blank lines a short cell
runs out of, which is where the reference puts it. Each case is pinned against
Python Rich 9d8f9a3's bytes.
